text: [A hurt man lies on his back in the dust, telling it to keep his mind off the pain, bitter at himself for being fooled.] [pained] Man in a faded red shirt. [short pause] Rode up easy, like he wanted directions. [long pause] [exhales sharply] Then he shot me.
